title: The Duskbloods official local asset collection
selection_note: Original official artwork and portraits bundled with this local fan game. No generated substitute artwork.

assets.name: Albert
assets.appearance_notes: Shaggy silver hair covering the eyes; stubble; ivory shirt; ornate jeweled brown-and-gold vest or mantle; black gloves. Official desktop modal composition; character shown from head to approximately hips, with a dark vignette and partially transparent outer edges.
assets.recommended_for: Large character artwork or card illustrations; use CSS crop to emphasize face and torso.
assets.quality_note: Largest complete desktop modal rendition referenced by the official stylesheet; not a full-body render.
